title: ARGES: sector routine and a level bust
objective: Run the ARGES routine with light traffic: assume, climb, transfer at the agreed level, and catch a level bust.
challenges: One crossing conflict to solve before STCA
A level bust in the middle of routine calls
criteria: No loss of separation (5 NM / 1000 ft)
Level bust seen and re-cleared within 60 s
Every flight assumed before entry and transferred at its agreed exit level

injects.text: A departure asks for its requested cruising level. Check the crossing traffic first.
Mode S selected level disagrees with the clearance. Watch the CFL and the SFL.
A transit asks for a higher level for the ride. Check the exit level agreement.
